content.title: Ames National (ATLO) Profit Margin Surge Challenges Prolonged Bearish Narratives
content.summary: Ames National (ATLO) posted a sharp earnings turnaround, reporting net profit margins of 23.7% compared to 18.6% a year earlier and annual EPS growth of 43.3%. This rebound follows a tough five-year stretch where earnings fell an average of 15.2% per year. The stock is trading at a 12.8x P/E ratio, which marks a premium to both the industry and peer group but remains below the fair value estimate of $23.88 at a share price of $19.61.
